scope: Reviewed discussion claims only; not full six-source reconciliation.

rows.conflict: Triage/write/maintain-admin requirements differ by operation and product.
rows.requirement: Bind operation, repository/source repository, role and exact platform/version; disputed privileges remain unknown pending independent evidence.
rows.negative_test: Cloud triage management cannot imply GHES deletion/category authority.

rows.conflict: Source repository permission inheritance and source reassignment differ data transfer.
rows.requirement: Record current source, affected discussions, destination permissions and approved migration/recovery plan; pointer change does not certify movement.
rows.negative_test: Changing organization source cannot mark old discussions transferred or recoverably preserved.

rows.conflict: Inherited visibility, owner-limited transfers and conversion preserve different identity/scope.
rows.requirement: Preview source/destination ownership, visibility, category and operation; check private/internal-public prohibition and announcement restriction.
rows.negative_test: Private-to-public or announcement transfer cannot pass; issue conversion cannot certify metadata/history parity.

rows.conflict: YAML syntax and sample rendering differ category/default-branch deployment and native input validation.
rows.requirement: Validate category slug/default branch, supported format and body non-Markdown field; keep render hints data and test actual scoped form behavior.
rows.negative_test: Parsed YAML or render:bash cannot authorize execution or certify form working for polls.

rows.conflict: Marked answers, closed discussions and editable form output are not accepted engineering evidence.
rows.requirement: Retain exact revision, criteria, accountable reviewer and independent acceptance outside mutable UI state.
rows.negative_test: Closed/resolved or required checkbox cannot automatically accept policy or certify correctness.

rows.conflict: Lock bypass, timed unblock and category deletion migration differ universal restriction and recoverability.
rows.requirement: Test authorized actor matrix, expiry and category/section membership effects with scoped approval and post-change evidence; retain unknown restoration.
rows.negative_test: Lock cannot certify writers barred; section deletion cannot imply discussion deletion or proven rollback.

rows.conflict: Aggregate activity, unique engaged users and answer ranking differ trust/access/quality.
rows.requirement: Record target/time/period/unit/privacy and complete declared denominator; independent access review precedes elevation.
rows.negative_test: High rank, reaction or pageview cannot prove trusted moderator or accepted outcome.

rows.conflict: Broad labels/formats/creation claims omit detailed scope exceptions.
rows.requirement: Preserve claim identities and exact version, category and operation; independently verify conflicts without broad parent wildcard inference.
rows.negative_test: Unqualified labels cannot create GHES support; any-access prose cannot override announcement/EMU/configured creation restrictions.

limitations: Negative tests specify proposed bindings, not executed implementations.
Identity verification does not certify mapping equivalence or omission completeness.
No rights clearance, public publication, access grants or native activation.
